resources.string: New AI writing and text assistance make creating easier
New text styles and free layout design
Add attachments and links to notes
All-new drawing board with a refreshed look
"Notes now has AI features, and many functions are new or improved to make note-taking easier\n"

"Create a note or open any note and tap the AI icon in the toolbar below to use AI features:
1. Write many kinds of text, such as articles and social posts, from scratch
2. Generate to-do lists and meeting agendas to plan life, study and travel
3. Continue, summarize, correct and translate existing notes
"
"Richer text editing with strikethrough, hyperlinks, highlighting and more for clearer content\n"
"Add attachments of any kind or web links to notes\n"
"Record audio and transcribe it to text in real time\n"
"Draw on the drawing board and insert the drawing into a note as an image\n"
"Add to-dos with time and location reminders\n"
Group and pin notes, and choose your own skin
